domain: Type 2 diabetes — GLP-1 / incretin therapy selection
title: Clinician Perceptions of Incretin-Based Therapies in Type 2 Diabetes
intro: Thank you for participating. This survey takes approximately 10 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your primary clinical role?
How many years have you been managing patients with type 2 diabetes?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.

questions.text: Which of the following medications for type 2 diabetes are you aware of?
What is your most important consideration when selecting a medication for a patient with inadequately controlled type 2 diabetes?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: Present options in the exact order listed above. Do not randomize.

questions.text: Which medication do you prescribe most often for inadequately controlled type 2 diabetes?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: The brand selected in Q3 must be piped into the text of Q4.

questions.text: How satisfied are you with [PIPE: Q3 selection] for your type 2 diabetes patients?

piping.note: Replace [PIPE: Q3 selection] with the brand chosen in Q3.

questions.text: Please rate your agreement with each of the following statements.
rows: GLP-1 receptor agonists have transformed type 2 diabetes management
Injection burden limits my patients' adherence to therapy
I am comfortable titrating these agents in patients with renal impairment

questions.text: What percentage of your type 2 diabetes patients currently receive a GLP-1 receptor agonist or dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

questions.text: In your view, what is the single biggest barrier to your patients’ access to these therapies?
How likely are you to recommend these therapies to a colleague managing type 2 diabetes?
questions.instruction: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
